exec.thesis: Six weeks changed the story's slope but not its shape. The fee re-acceleration the July price was 'pre-paying' has now begun showing up: 30d fees +22% to $4.07M, blended take rate up 0.77→0.97bps, and the trailing WEEK ran ~$275K/day — roughly 2x the 30d average — as three catalysts stacked: the Robinhood Chain 50/50 revenue-share went from rumor to confirmed (live since Jul 1, now $3.65B/30d volume, ~8.7% of total), Novakovski took a CFTC Innovation Advisory Committee seat (inaugural meeting Aug 20), and Upbit listed LIT/KRW (Aug 24, +22% intraday). But price ran faster than fundamentals: +52% from $2.45 to $3.73 pushed FDV/run-rate fees from ~60x to ~75x and compressed the buyback yield from 5.1% to 3.2% — LIT re-rated toward Hyperliquid's multiple while the Dec 27-30 cliff moved four months closer, and at $3.73 that cliff now represents ~$52M/month of new supply. The trade discipline is unchanged: this remains a watchlist name where the structural entry is cliff-driven weakness, not an Upbit-squeeze chase — with one new upside caveat: if the trailing-week fee rate holds, the multiple compresses back to ~37x and the re-rate is justified.
own: Value accrual intact and about to compound: 100% of trading fees still fund buybacks (cumulative 6.61% of supply bought, 5.99% burned); Q3 pool has $4.13M+ accrued toward burn #2 (~early Oct if the Jul cadence repeats).

Robinhood is now revenue, not narrative: 50/50 revenue-share confirmed live since Jul 1; Robinhood Chain already ~8.7% of volume ($3.65B/30d) with equities-as-collateral shipped and an $11-25M incentive program settling weekly in LIT since Aug 21.

Regulatory positioning no peer has: founder seated on the CFTC's Innovation Advisory Committee (Aug 20 inaugural) — the only perp DEX with a principal inside the US rule-making conversation; Upbit KRW listing adds the Korean retail bid.
avoid: Price outran proof: +52% in six weeks vs. +22% fee growth expanded the multiple to ~75x trailing; the fee 'surge' is concentrated in the last 7-10 days and is partly sector beta (HYPE hit its ATH the same week). Q3-to-date daily revenue (~$108K/day) is still only flat with Q2.

The supply wall got bigger in dollars: Dec 27-30 cliff starts ~13.9M LIT/month for 36 months — at $3.73 that's ~$52M/month against ~$2M of ±2% book depth, and no re-lock or OTC program has been announced (unlike Monad's).

The 50/50 deal cuts both ways: Robinhood Chain revenue is NOT yet flowing to the buyback (DeFiLlama shows $0 holders-revenue on that leg) — the headline flatters the token more than current plumbing delivers; plus the $11-25M incentive pool is fresh LIT supply hitting weekly.
questions: Does the trailing-week fee rate (~$275K/day) hold through September, or fade with the Upbit/squeeze froth? This single variable decides whether 75x is cheap or expensive.
When does Robinhood Chain's revenue share start routing to LIT buybacks — and at what split after Robinhood's 50%?
Will Lighter run a Monad-style re-lock/OTC program for the Dec cliff? Nothing announced; watch for it as the single biggest de-risking event.
Does Novakovski's CFTC seat translate into a licensed US path (the substitution-threat neutralizer) or stay symbolic?

biz.narrative: Lighter is a ZK-rollup order-book perp DEX: free for retail, paid for professionals. Standard accounts pay 0/0 maker-taker (with deliberate 200-300ms latency); opt-in Premium accounts pay 0.004%/0.028% with lower latency, discountable by staking LIT. Blended take rate is now ~0.97bps of volume (up from 0.77bps in July as fee mix shifts premium and the Robinhood leg adds retail flow). 100% of zkLighter trading-fee revenue funds continuous buybacks (burned quarterly). New since July: the protocol now runs TWO deployments — core zkLighter plus Robinhood Chain (live Jul 1, 50/50 revenue split with Robinhood, $3.65B/30d volume, $540K/30d fees) — and the Robinhood leg's revenue does not yet route to the buyback. The Feb '26 Circle deal (~$40M/yr est. float income on ~$920M platform USDC) still accrues to the company, not the token. Liquidation fees route to the LLP pool. Team remains lean; operating leverage is extreme in both directions.
notes: The inflection is recent and narrow: trailing-7d fees $1.93M (~$275K/day) vs. $135K/day 30d average — the surge is concentrated in the Aug 18-27 window (Upbit + CFTC + sector rally). Q3-to-date gross revenue ($6.38M, ~$108K/day) is still roughly flat with Q2's pace.
Quarterly income: Q4'25 $39.7M → Q1'26 $19.7M → Q2'26 $9.6M → Q3-to-date $6.38M (64% elapsed). The decline has FLATTENED; it has not yet reversed on a quarterly basis.
Robinhood Chain leg booked separately: $543K cumulative fees, $0 to holders so far. The 50/50 split means Robinhood captures its half before any buyback allocation on that leg.
Circle float income (~$40M/yr est.) still rivals all trading fees and still sits at the opco — unchanged, still the biggest unpriced lever.

moat.note: Two scores upgraded since July: Brand 3→4 (Robinhood partnership live + Upbit listing) and Regulatory 2→3 (Novakovski on the CFTC Innovation Advisory Committee — unique among perp DEXs). Liquidity still far behind Hyperliquid, which holds ~71% of the HL/Aster/Lighter volume trio vs. Lighter's ~13%. Tech edge (SNARK-verified order book) unchanged and still durable ~18-24mo.

liquidity.summary: Liquidity improved with the rally: aggregate ±2% depth ≈ $1.9M ask / $2.3M bid (top-10 venues) vs. ~$1.5M total in July, and spot ADV is up ~38% to ~$77M across 38 markets. Lighter's own DEX book is now the deepest single ask-side venue ($495K +2%). New: Upbit LIT/KRW (Aug 24) adds the Korean retail bid — historically a venue that amplifies both squeezes and dumps. Blocks above ~$3M still need TWAP or perp-hedged execution; the Dec cliff's ~$52M/month would be ~2.3% of monthly spot volume at current rates.

tech.narrative: zkLighter is an app-specific ZK-rollup settling to Ethereum with a verifiable order book: SNARK proofs cover the exchange logic itself — price-time priority matching, margin checks, liquidations. This remains the genuine differentiator vs. Hyperliquid (own L1, trust-the-validators) and CEXs (trust-the-operator). The architecture now spans two deployments: core zkLighter plus the Robinhood Chain leg (live Jul 1 '26), where Robinhood Stock Tokens (NVDA, GOOG, AAPL) are accepted as perp collateral — the first equities-as-margin implementation in the sector. Embedded bull assumption: verifiability + Robinhood distribution + a seat inside the CFTC conversation wins the institutional/US flow as perps legitimize. Embedded risk: single centralized sequencer (Oct 10 '25 outage, 4.5h, LLP −5.35%) — still no public decentralization date.

catalysts.mid: The 12-36mo re-rating still rests on three legs, now partially de-risked: (1) durable non-incentive volume — Robinhood Chain is real ($3.65B/30d) but incentive-fueled; the sticky-flow test comes when the points pool expires; (2) token-directed economics expanding — RH-leg revenue routing to buybacks and/or Circle float income (~$40M/yr est., still at the opco) being pledged; either would materially compress the effective multiple; (3) the US path — Novakovski's CFTC seat is the sector's best regulatory option value, against the Kalshi/Coinbase substitution threat. Compression scenario unchanged: Hyperliquid (~71% share, ATH the same week) keeps absorbing the category's economics and LIT's multiple converges to its fee share rather than its story.

scenarios.name: Bull
scenarios.body: Trailing-week fee rate holds and compounds ($100M+ ann.), RH-leg revenue routes to buybacks, re-lock program defuses the cliff, burns keep retiring supply. Market pays 35-40x growing fees — the Robinhood-distribution thesis realized.
scenarios.trip: Tripwires: fees >$8M/30d · RH holders-rev >$0 · re-lock announced · cliff absorbed <20% drawdown

scenarios.name: Base
scenarios.body: Fee rate settles between Q2's floor and August's spike (~$60-70M/yr), multiple compresses toward 50x as the cliff approaches, buyback (~$30M/yr pace) absorbs a fifth of unlock flow. Choppy range into December, cliff-driven flush, then recovery.
scenarios.trip: Tripwires: fees $4-6M/30d · float >30% absorbed through H1 '27 · staking holds >40% of float

scenarios.name: Bear
scenarios.body: August proves to be froth: Upbit/squeeze flow fades, RH volume collapses post-incentives, fees revert to ~$100K/day, and the cliff hits a 75x-priced token with no re-lock. Retest of the $1.50-2.00 zone where the multiple math clears.
scenarios.trip: Tripwires: fees <$3M/30d · RH-leg volume −50% post-expiry · no re-lock by Nov · burn cadence missed

variant: July's variant (own the unlock, the buyback is a structural bid) is now half-consensus — so the new variant is about the Robinhood headline: the market is pricing the 50/50 revenue share as token-accretive, but the plumbing says otherwise — DeFiLlama shows $0 of Robinhood Chain revenue flowing to holders; Robinhood takes its half and the rest sits unrouted. The 'boring' catalyst nobody is watching is a plumbing announcement that routes RH-leg revenue into the buyback — small dollars today ($360K/30d rev) but it converts the sector's flashiest partnership from narrative to cash flow, and it's exactly the kind of low-cost, high-signal move this team has made twice (burns, staking). Conversely, the crowd chasing the CFTC-seat narrative should note advisory committees confer influence, not licenses. Positioning: fade the froth, own the cliff flush, and treat RH-revenue-routing + re-lock announcements as the two asymmetric long triggers.

valuation.embedded: At $3.73 the market pays ~75x trailing fees — up from ~60x in July despite fees growing — which means the price now embeds the trailing-WEEK rate (~$275K/day → ~$100M/yr → ~37x) as the new normal, plus Robinhood stickiness, plus an orderly cliff. Each is plausible; all three at once is the bull case, not the base case. The reverse math: to earn a market return from here at a 35x exit, fees need to roughly hold August's spike rate permanently and grow from there.

synthesis: The July thesis said the price was paying for a re-acceleration that hadn't shown up; it has now started to — take rate up, Robinhood volume real, regulatory optionality unique — but the market has again paid ahead of the proof, at ~75x trailing with the $52M/month supply spigot four months out and the flashiest catalyst (50/50 revenue share) not yet wired to the token. Lighter keeps executing; the stock of things to like grew. The price grew faster.
recText: Recommendation: still watchlist — do not chase the +52%. Tactical framework: fade strength above ~$4 (75x+ trailing), accumulate cliff-driven weakness in the $2.00-2.50 zone (where the multiple clears ~40x and the Aug 16 low proved buyable), size up only on the two asymmetric triggers: RH-leg revenue routing to buybacks, or a re-lock/OTC program for the December cliff. Priority follow-ups: weekly DeFiLlama fee rate through September, and burn #2 timing/size in early October.
